notes.title: 3800 Hours of Development and Counting
notes.content:
Hi all!

Hard to believe but we've spent [i]3815.86 hours[/i] working on Freemium Way. This includes assets creation, server development, and the hardest yet most interesting part — Unity client, the game itself.

Indie gamedev involves a lot of experimenting routine and sometimes this makes a lot of distraction.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29261588/c8beaedb3d5761e5c4922eb67db8e22ee8f57524.jpg[/img]

Sometimes it's very fun and productive. Like the following Battles prototype:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29261588/9d77c3741bf00dd45c15bb92e1d9d363449c75ba.jpg[/img]

Happy Winter Sale everyone!
[i]And do not forget to farm all the trading cards.[/i]
